note: Golden key-derivation vectors for the RW media channel (docs/PROTOCOL.md §9.3). Inputs are synthetic (not a real secret). Every implementation MUST reproduce these values exactly, using the same lowercase-hex SHA-256 as core/sha256.cpp.

formulas.nonce_prefix: first 8 bytes of sha256('rwh-media-nonce-v1|' + session_key_hex + '|' + window_id)
